description.fun: Tropius ate the same fruit so often that bunches of banana-like fruit started growing around its neck, ripening twice a year; people and Pokémon can pick and eat them, and in Alola they're especially sweet. Despite its bulk, it flies nimbly on the big leaves on its back, and in warm places there are ranches that raise it. It was also the first Pokémon ever handed out in a Cherish Ball.
description.guide: A Grass- and Flying-type Pokémon resembling a long-necked sauropod, with banana-like fruit on its neck and leaves for wings. It lives in tropical jungles. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A flying dinosaur that grows bunches of fruit around its neck
